titleTr: Sınıfta bir olay: üçüncü koşul (If I had known...)

grammar.topic: 3rd conditional (if + had + V3, would have + V3)
explainTr: Üçüncü koşul, geçmişte olmuş bir şeyin tersini hayal eder: If I had seen the puddle, I would have put a towel there. (Gördüm demek yok, göremedim.)
Yapı: if + had + V3, would have + V3. Sonuç kısmında could have veya might have de olur: If she hadn't run, she might not have fallen.
Dikkat: if'ten sonra 'would have' kullanma. If I would have known diyen çok kişi var ama doğrusu: If I had known.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Bilseydim yapardım' tek yapıdır. İngilizcede zaman net: geçmiş için if + had + V3 ve would have + V3 gerekir. Şimdiki zaman için ayrı yapı vardır (If I knew, I would do).

reading.title: A small accident in science class
reading.text:
Last Thursday, Hafsa worked as a substitute teacher at Lincoln Elementary for the first time. Her class was Ms. Carter's fourth grade, and the morning went well until a small accident changed everything.

During science, the students were making a model of a volcano. A boy named Tyler carried a cup of water across the room while he was talking to his friend. He did not notice the water spilling on the floor behind him. A minute later, a girl named Maya ran to the sink, slipped, and fell. She hit her elbow on a desk and started to cry.

Hafsa stayed calm. She asked the students to stay in their seats, helped Maya sit up, and sent a student to the front office to get Mr. Brown. Within five minutes, the school nurse arrived. Maya had a bruise, but nothing was broken. The nurse called Maya's parents, and Maya went home early.

After lunch, Hafsa wrote an incident report. She felt worried, so she thought about the accident again and again. "If Tyler had been more careful, the water wouldn't have spilled," she wrote in her notes. "If I had checked the floor earlier, I would have seen the puddle. And if Maya hadn't been running, she might not have fallen."

Mr. Brown read the report and smiled. "You did the right thing," he said. "If you hadn't stayed calm, the other students would have panicked. And if you hadn't sent for help quickly, Maya would have waited much longer."

That evening, Hafsa told her son Emre about the day. "I made a few mistakes," she said. "If I had known about the experiment, I would have put a towel next to the sink." Emre listened and answered, "Mom, if you hadn't been there, nobody would have known what to do. You were great."

On Friday, Ms. Carter sent her a short message: "Thank you for yesterday. Maya is fine, and the class made a new rule: no running with water!" Hafsa read it twice and felt proud.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hafsa, I read your incident report about Thursday. Can we talk for a minute?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Of course. I'm still thinking about it. If I had checked the floor, Maya wouldn't have fallen.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Please don't blame yourself. Tyler spilled the water, and nobody saw it.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: True, but I was supervising the class. I should have noticed the puddle.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Maybe. But look at the result. If you hadn't acted quickly, the injury could have been worse.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: The nurse was very fast. If she had been in a meeting, we would have called an ambulance.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Exactly. By the way, one witness wrote a short note. A girl named Lily saw everything.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That's helpful. Did Maya's mother call?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Yes, this morning. She said Maya is fine and only has a small bruise on her arm.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: What a relief. I would have felt terrible if she had broken a bone.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Next time, we will keep a mop in the science room. That could prevent the problem.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good idea. I'll add it to my notes for the next substitute.

writing.promptTr: Ms. Carter'a kısa bir olay notu yaz. Sınıfta küçük bir kaza oldu; ne olduğunu anlat ve en az üç tane 'if + had + V3, would have + V3' cümlesi kullan. 120-180 kelime.
writing.promptEn: Write a short note to Ms. Carter about a small accident in class. Explain what happened and use at least three third conditional sentences (120-180 words).
frames: Dear Ms. Carter, I want to tell you about ...
writing.model: Dear Ms. Carter, I want to tell you about a small accident that happened during science class on Thursday. A student named Tyler spilled a cup of water near the sink, and another student, Maya, slipped and fell. She hit her elbow and had a small bruise. I stayed calm and sent a student to the office for help. The nurse arrived in five minutes. If Tyler had been more careful, the water wouldn't have spilled. If I had checked the floor earlier, I would have seen the puddle. If the nurse hadn't come quickly, Maya might have waited much longer for help. Luckily, nobody was seriously hurt. In the future, I think we should keep a mop in the science room and remind students to walk, not run. Please call me if you have any questions. Thank you for trusting me with your class. Sincerely, Hafsa
